values./system/biography: The final replicas include unfinished copies of the player characters. They possess stolen memories and a disturbing resemblance to the people they replace.
values./items/@qhC4YwPxj4FB6pIW/system/descript: Developed by The Institute after the Great War, Institute lasers differ in design and function from the pre-War lasers used by other factions such as the Brotherhood of Steel. Eschewing raw power for a rapid succession of beams, these lasers can lay down a searing volley of suppressive fire.
values./items/@A77iQQLjMKpTG4D1/system/descript: A collapsible baton of the sort used by police departments and private security forces before the Great War. Vault-Tec security within each vault had a stock of these, so they remain in common use as a lightweight back-up melee weapon.
values./items/@RXmOc1NdwQQn7RfO/system/descript: The synth is a robot. They are immune to the effects of starvation, thirst, and suffocation. They are also immune to Poison and Radiation damage. However, machines cannot use food and drink or other consumables, they do not heal naturally, and the Medicine skill cannot be used to heal them: damage to them must be repaired.
values./items/@QChQJ9QZHqMa8jBF/system/descript: The synth cannot be intimidated or threatened in any way and will either ignore or attack anyone who attempts to threaten or intimidate it.
values./items/@vFBcleoDVSY9A7Nf/system/descript: The synth is immune to the effects of all diseases, and they will never suffer the symptoms of any disease.
values./items/@JLSviAhNqtQ2Mzf0/system/effect: Institute Laser Gun (Photon Exciter, Improved Barrel), Shock Baton, 3d20 Fusion Cells, Synth Leg x2, Synth Arm x2, Synth Helmet x1.
values./items/@w2L5Ax6zGtXLu4o1/system/descript: These synths can pass as human, and any attempt to inspect them reveals them to be human. Third-generation synths can only be identified after death by the recovery of their Synth Component. A Thirdgeneration synth posing as a known figure gains a bonus 2d20 to any rolls relating to impersonating the individual, including recalling knowledge and expressing their mannerisms.
values./items/@adv446f7070656c6/system/descript: Replace a doppelganger's attacks with the weapons used by the player character it copies. It gains +1 Defense against attacks made by that character.
values./items/@EawYhE0ig3n6ex5B/system/descript: The synth reduces all Poison damage suffered to 0 and cannot suffer any damage or effects from poison.
values./items/@CxHQQtgCCjQDPhOX/system/descript: The synth reduces all Radiation damage suffered to 0 and cannot suffer any damage or effects from radiation.
